about: Instructions each benchmark's measured region runs, counted by Callgrind on x86-64 Linux at the AVX2 SIMD level. CI fails a pull request that makes any of them more than 3 % higher; change them only with `cargo xtask bench --update-baseline --reason ...`, and say why in the pull request.
reason: R0.14: making an instance now asks the plug-in for its parameter space and the host link keeps the slots' selection, and loading state checks whether a slot changed its module; about 200 instructions more to create an instance and 35 more to load state, on the main thread only. Processing is unchanged.
